title: Mask My File
hero: Find private details, choose exactly what to hide, and share a verified copy without losing the useful context.
formatsTitle: One private workflow for every supported file
formatsText: Preview images and PDFs at full width, zoom up to 5×, and draw precise areas by hand. Search every match in Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV, and RTF, then use stars, partial masks, placeholders, pseudonyms, or removal. Metadata is removed where the format supports it.
verifyText: Mask My File creates a new copy, reopens it, and verifies that the protected file is still valid before showing Private Ready. Your original is never overwritten.
batchText: Give every file its own preview and manual selections, search the same private text across the whole set, then export the verified copies together.
supportTitle: Protect a file in three clear steps
supportIntro: Use Mask My File before sending an application, medical document, customer record, screenshot, or any file that contains details others do not need to see.
step1: Choose a photo, PDF, document, structured-data file, or pasted text. Scanning starts locally on your device.
step2: Review every finding. Add missed text or draw an exact area, then choose one of the protection styles supported by that file type.
step3: Create the protected copy. Share only after Private Ready confirms that the new output reopened and passed verification.
faqText: It means the newly protected copy was rendered, reopened, and checked for valid file structure. It does not replace your own final visual review before sharing.
contactText: Email hourstag.app@gmail.com with your device model, iOS version, file type, and a short description.
privacyIntro: Mask My File is designed to protect files without collecting them. No account is required, and the app contains no advertising, tracking, analytics, or content-upload service.
deviceText: Apple Vision and the embedded Tesseract OCR engine scan selected content locally. Masking, redaction, metadata removal, export, and verification also run on the device.
faceText: Face detection only marks image regions for your review. Mask My File does not identify people, create biometric or identity templates, upload face data, share it, or retain separate face data.
storeTitle: Purchases are the only network service
storeText: Apple processes the optional lifetime purchase and restoration through StoreKit. Mask My File does not use a VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter, or network routing.
retentionText: Originals are never overwritten. Temporary workspace files, saved projects, Placeholder Vault mappings, and Private Session data remain only as each feature explains. Delete them in the app or remove the app to erase its local container.
